title: Old String and Tripwire Textures
description: Bring back old string and tripwire texture transparency before 26.1 release
body:
# Old String and Tripwire Textures
This pack simply bring back the old String textures.

Since minecraft has changed the tripwire texture rendering system, the strings are rendering with alpha cutout instead of transparent shader, and it's bad. ([Patch notes](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-26-1-snapshot-3))

There is a preview of the pack :
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91bc6b9e55f536e8fc081e746e0c04a54d5c9842.png)

Enjoy !
